status: Research only; production decoder remains unchanged

method.order: baseline, AVX2, AVX2, baseline per recording
method.live_input: Original-rate iq_file_to_stdout; complete 40.01 s narrow files and the same 10 s reference segments as the frontend study
method.cpu: Decoder process user + system CPU across all threads, excluding feeder/GTK/video
method.viterbi_cpu: CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID around complete live_viterbi_stream_decode_bytes calls, including depuncture/ACS/normalization/traceback/packing
method.instrumentation: Identical process/thread/IQ/drop counters in baseline and candidate. The existing sampled ACS wall-time breakdown is not used for CPU claims.

implementation.scope: DVB-T streaming ACS loop only; independent handwritten AVX2 float prototype
preserved: Original 1e30 bound and scalar best-state reduction order
Puncturing, per-step normalization, traceback length, chunk/reset behavior, buffering and latency
implementation.vector_work: Eight states at a time; deinterleave predecessor metrics with shuffles; permute four branch costs; add/compare/blend; pack survivor bits with movemask
implementation.portability: Research binary requires AVX2. Production integration would need runtime AVX2 selection and the existing scalar fallback.

kernel.measurement: Unpaced synthetic FEC 2/3 streaming Viterbi; not end-to-end live speed

per_step.stdout: DVB-T streaming FEC 1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 5/6, 7/8: exact bytes, puncturing, errors, chunk continuity and reset passed

coverage: Independent convolutional encoder and puncturing for FEC 1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 5/6, 7/8
Clean and sparse bit errors, whole and variable OFDM-symbol chunks, EOF tails and resets
Deterministic random floating-point costs at two scales, all ties, and erased bursts
Every step compares all 64 float metric bytes, all 64 survivor bits, the best float metric bytes and chosen best state

limits: One x86_64 AVX2 host, two live runs per variant; no ARM/SSE performance claim.
Full IQ tests cover FEC 1/2 and 2/3; the other three rates have independent encoder/per-step tests, not recorded-IQ benchmarks.
These are CPU savings, not improved sensitivity or additional recovered packets.
The prototype is not integrated and has no automatic CPU dispatch.
Maximum RSS can include inherited process high-water marks; no memory-saving claim.
No DVB-S implementation changes or measurements in this phase.
